REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 23, 2015 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
APRIL 23, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Dr. William Hundley, House of Worship International
  Ministries.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Boy Scout Troop 693.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Presentations were made as follows:

  Extreme Autowerks (Business Spotlight)

  Gerardo Gorospe (Eagle Scout)

5B.  Consideration of appointments to Commissions, Committees, and Boards (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the following
  nominees by Mark Pulido to Commissions, Committees, and Boards for a two-year term
  effective April 23, 2015 through March 31, 2017 (COUNCIL):

  Mark Pulido

  Carmelita Lampino  Economic Development Commission
  Nora Benzon  Fine Arts and Historical Commission
  Tatiana Yokoyama Bui  Planning Commission
  Joe Frontino  Parks and Recreation Commission
  Levi Javier  Property Preservation Commission
  Pat Patnaik  Community Safety Committee
  Beverly Porter  Community Safety Committee
  Cindy Yen Chen  Let Freedom Ring Committee
  Marco Garcia  Let Freedom Ring Committee
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2015

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

5B.  (continued)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chris Tierheimer spoke regarding the General Municipal Election, a local newspaper,
  and statewide water restrictions.

  Morris Setki spoke regarding the pine tree on his residential street.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated
  April 23, 2015 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register
  of Demands dated April 23, 2015 in the total amount of $3,998, 649.09 (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency dated
  April 23, 2015 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register
  of Demands dated April 23, 2015 in the total amount of $399.21 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  April 9, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of April 9, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2015

7C.  (continued)

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration and award of Bid No. 1199-15, printing of the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts 2015-2016 Season Brochure (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Marketing Supervisor.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to award Bid No. 1199-
  15 for the printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2015-2016 Season
  Brochure to Advantage Mailing, Inc. in the amount of $110,860.38 (COUNCIL). The
  motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration and award of Bid No. 1203-15, for the purchase of four
  (4) pairs of regulation soccer goals (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Ray, to award Bid No. 1203-15 for
  the purchase four pairs of Regulation Soccer Goals to Soccer Central in the amount of
  $23,044.64 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2015

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Cerritos parkway tree
  maintenance, Bid No. 1205-15 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Morris Setki inquired as to the priority order for tree trimming.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:
  1. Authorize the use of unexpended funds in the Fiscal Year 2014-2015 budget for tree
  trimming services; and
  2. Award a contract in the amount of $137,165.00 for Cerritos Parkway Tree
  Maintenance, Bid No. 1205-15, to Golden West Arbor Services and reject all other
  bids; and
  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders, in an amount not to exceed a total project cost of $250,000.00 (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

10B1. Review and consideration of support for (State Legislation) Assembly Bill 347
  (Chang) which proposes to streamline the Los Angeles County's City Selection
  Committee proxy process (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to direct staff to send a
  letter of support for Assembly Bill 347 to the following: Assemblymember Ling-Ling
  Chang, Assembly Committee on Local Government, Senator Tony Mendoza,
  Assemblymember Cristina Garcia, Los Angeles Division of the League of California
  Cities, California Contract Cities, Gateway Cities Council of Governments, Independent
  Cities Association, and Gonsalves and Son (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as
  follows:

  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido, Solanki, and Edwards, Mayor Pro
  Tem Ray and Mayor Chen.

12.  Closed Session

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session to consider the following two items.

12A.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION (COUNCIL).
  Pursuant to Paragraph (1) of subdivision (d) of Government Code Section
  54945.9
  Name of Case: City of Cerritos, et al v. Water Replenishment District of Southern
  California
  Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. BS128136

12B.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION (COUNCIL).
  Pursuant to Paragraph (1) of subdivision (d) of Government Code Section
  54945.9
  Name of Case: Water Replenishment District of Southern California v. City of
  Cerritos
  Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. VC060498

  Report from Closed Session:

  The City Council met in Closed Session to discuss items 12A and 12B on the Closed
  Session agenda. Following the Closed Session, the City Council reconvened in the
  Council Chamber and the City Attorney reported as follows:

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to unanimously approve a
  final settlement of the two litigation matters (Items 12A and 12B). Other approvals and
  signatures are required. Once obtained, the settlement agreement shall be available to
  the public (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:50 p.m.
